evidence.quote: In the world of bank supervision, our equivalent of the trireme has been the stress test.
Borrowers are facing unemployment, cash flow disruptions, and continued economic uncertainty.
As we've said many times, the scenarios are not projections or predictions.
The aggregate common equity ratio across large banks increased from 12 percent at the end of 2019 to 12.8 percent at the end of 2020.
